<section>Chapter 21. "H" Extension for Hypervisor Support, Version 1.0 > 21.2. Hypervisor and Virtual Supervisor CSRs > 21.2.12. Virtual Supervisor Interrupt (** **`vsip` and** **`vsie` ) Registers > Figure 100. Virtual supervisor interrupt-pending register (_ `vsip` _).</section>
<previous> are VSXLEN-bit read/write registers that are VS-mode’s versions of supervisor CSRs `sip` and `sie` , formatted as shown in Figure 100 and Figure 101 respectively. When V=1, `vsip` and `vsie` substitute for the usual `sip` and `sie` , so instructions that normally read or modify `sip` / `sie` actually access `vsip` / `vsie` instead. However, interrupts directed to HS-level continue to be indicated in the HS-level `sip` register, not in `vsip` , when V=1.
